title: chestseek
description: Search any open chest: matching items stay bright while the rest dim, and it even peeks inside shulker boxes.
body:
# ChestSeek
Find what you need in a packed chest instantly. Type a search and ChestSeek highlights the matching items while dimming everything else.

## Features
- Live search box in any container screen
- Matching slots stay bright, non-matching slots dim
- Searches inside shulker boxes too
- Configurable dim strength and toggle key

## How to use
Open a chest, press the search key, and start typing an item name.

Client-side. Requires Fabric API and Yet Another Config Lib (YACL).
